question: F, G, H, I, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F. Only two people sit between G and M, when counted from right of G. Only three people sit between F and N, when counted from the right of F. H sits to the immediate left of I. Who sits third to the left of O?
solution:
Given:
